>
> Hi Bob,
>

> 1. Does stan/R has a graphical interface that facilitate its use ?
No. Just R.
> 2. can I integrate the algorithm that generates my Bayesian graph in an other framework such as a network simulator (like ns2, omnet, ns3, etc) ?.

I don't know what those are, but if it's a combinatorially intractable
discrete problem (as I suspect it is), you won't be able to code
it in Stan.

Stan's for expressing continuously differentiable log densities.
